explain.say: Here are ways to say hello. With words: Hello, Hi Mia, or Good morning. Without words: a wave, a smile, a thumbs up or a nod. They are all kind. Well done! Your challenge: say hello one way to someone today.

faq.q: What words can I say to say hello?
faq.a: You can say Hello, Hi, or Good morning. Adding their name, like Hi, Mia, makes it extra friendly.

faq.q: Do I have to look in someone's eyes?
faq.a: No. You can look at their face, their nose or their shoulder. Turning towards them shows you are saying hello to them.
asks: Tell me about Look and smile

faq.q: What if talking is hard for me?
faq.a: You can wave, smile, nod or give a thumbs up. These all say hello without words.
asks: Tell me about A wave works too

faq.q: How does the other person feel when I say hello?
faq.a: Most people feel happy and noticed. It shows you are friendly.
asks: Tell me about Mia feels happy

faq.q: What if they do not say hello back?
faq.a: Maybe they did not hear, or they are busy. That is okay. You were kind. You can try again later.

facts: People around the world greet each other in many ways, such as a wave, a bow, a handshake or a nod.
In Japan, a small bow is a common way to say hello.

quiz.say: Which of these is a way to say hello without words?
quiz.show: A way to say hello without words?
quiz.why: A wave says hello, even with no words.

wrong.1: Turning away can look like you do not want to talk.
wrong.2: Hiding means the person cannot see your hello.

quiz.say: Tunde says hello. How might Mia feel?
quiz.why: A hello makes most people feel happy and noticed.

wrong.1: A friendly hello does not usually make people cross.
wrong.2: A kind hello is not scary.
